2026-09-23.title: Ely Launch Event
2026-09-23.description: Join Boundary Waters supporters and cyclists at Puddle Jumper Park in Ely as the Pedal to the Polls journey gets underway. Help us pack the park as we send Dave and Amy off on their journey! There will be food, great company, and the first opportunity to sign the canoe in support of permanent protection.
